query: Периодически выбирай новые записи из PostgreSQL public.orders и сохраняй их в JSON-файл /data/output/orders_export.json.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: postgres_to_json_orders
  name: PostgreSQL Orders to JSON Export
  description: Периодически выбирает новые записи из таблицы public.orders в PostgreSQL
    и сохраняет их в JSON-файл /data/output/orders_export.json
triggers:
- id: trigger_schedule
  type: schedule
  condition: every 5 minutes
sources:
- id: source_postgres_orders
  name: Read New Orders from PostgreSQL
  type: PostgreSQL
  location: public.orders
  connection:
    properties:
      host: '{{POSTGRES_HOST}}'
      port: '{{POSTGRES_PORT}}'
      database: '{{POSTGRES_DATABASE}}'
      username: '{{POSTGRES_USERNAME}}'
      password: '{{POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}'
processing_elements:
- id: process_filter_new_records
  name: Filter New Records
  operation: Filter
  config:
    condition: created_at > {{LAST_PROCESSED_TIMESTAMP}}
    watermark_field: created_at
    state_store: last_processed_timestamp
- id: process_serialize_json
  name: Serialize to JSON
  operation: Serialize
  config:
    format: json
    pretty_print: 'false'
sinks:
- id: sink_json_file
  name: Write to JSON File
  type: File
  location: /data/output/orders_export.json
  connection:
    properties:
      write_mode: append
      file_format: json
processed_data:
- id: orders_raw
  format: tabular
- id: orders_json
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_postgres_orders
  to_id: process_filter_new_records
  data_ref: orders_raw
- from_id: process_filter_new_records
  to_id: process_serialize_json
  data_ref: orders_raw
- from_id: process_serialize_json
  to_id: sink_json_file
  data_ref: orders_json
